messages:
Lena (CSM): Quick heads-up — VeloxHealth sent their vendor risk form and an urgent DPA follow-up. They asked for SOC2 evidence, KMS key provenance, and our embeddings retention policy. They want docs by EOD.
Derek (Solutions): I can handle the embeddings retention language and the code snippet showing TTL.
Nina (Security): I'll pull the KMS provenance and a redact-friendly rotation export. If BuildBot can snapshot key policies that helps.
BuildBot: Automated export started: `evidence-export --org veloxhealth --types kms,policies` — job id eb-994.
Omar (Legal): I'll prepare a short DPA addendum draft. Prefer we bundle evidence into a single PDF with a manifest.
Lena (CSM): I'll upload Velox's questionnaire to the shared folder: drive/veloxhealth/risk-answers.
Theo (SRE): Heads-up: rotation logs include principal ARNs; will need redaction step. I can redact service-account principals but that adds ~2 hours.
Derek (Solutions): Is redaction mandatory for them? Some customers accept redacted CSV + manifest.
Nina (Security): Yes, redacted logs + attestation are fine. We'll mark what was redacted in the manifest.
Omar (Legal): Confirmed. Manifest should list file names and redaction rationale. I'll attach the signed cover letter.
Lena (CSM): Timeline check: can we have a bundle by 18:00 PST? I will tell Velox we aim for that but might slip +1 day if redaction runs late.
Theo (SRE): ETA: raw export complete in 15m, redaction finish in ~90m.
BuildBot: Evidence archive uploaded to s3://evidence-bundles/veloxhealth/eb-994.tar.gz
Derek (Solutions): I'll prepare the embedding TTL snippet and a short explanatory paragraph citing PDOC-231.
Nina (Security): Also adding network controls summary: VPC peering not allowed, egress filtered, and access via the control plane only. Short bullets.
Omar (Legal): I'll draft the cover letter and DPA addendum template and place in the drive. Lena, please confirm recipient email for delivery.
Lena (CSM): Contact: security@veloxhealth.com and legal@veloxhealth.com. I'll coordinate the delivery window.
Derek (Solutions): Once archive is in drive I'll create evidence-bundle-velox-v1.zip and drop manifest.json (redacted fields described).
Lena (CSM): Thanks team. I'll schedule a 10min huddle at 17:30 PST to validate packet before sending. Please flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
Theo (SRE): If legal needs original ARNs for audit we may need an internal NDA escalate. Flagging as low risk for now.
Nina (Security): Noted. I'll prepare an internal note in case they request full logs.
Lena (CSM): Great — I'll update Velox with "collecting docs; ETA EOD today, possible +1 day for PII redaction".
